description: This file defines the 'Details' feature for articles, including a request query class, validator, and handler for fetching article details by slug.

classes.name: Details.Query
classes.description: Request object encapsulating the article slug for fetching details.

classes.name: Details.QueryValidator
classes.description: Validates that the slug is not null or empty.

classes.name: Details.QueryHandler
classes.description: Handles the request to retrieve article details by slug from the database.

methods.name: Handle
methods.description: Asynchronously retrieves an article by slug and returns it wrapped in an envelope, or throws a RestException if not found.
